resume: One file of release notes, versioned with the code: each change written in its pull request without a number, numbered and dated when it is merged or released, with the stories it ships; shown to the users as « What's new ».
apporte: A release-notes file in the repository, one entry per version: number, date and time, title, changes, stories
Entries written in each pull request as « next », without number nor time: no conflict between pull requests
The number and the time given at the merge, or at the release that groups the « next » entries
A « What's new » page, newest first, each story linked to its issue
Checks that refuse an entry without its stories, or a « next » entry on the production branch

demande.description: The release-notes file declared in .fabrique.json (version.fichier) and the form of its numbers (version.forme)
A merge workflow that numbers the entries of the pull request (workflows.fusionner), and a release workflow for a project without integration branch (workflows.publier)
The project's tests or CI run the check on each pull request
